persian.name: Anisha
persian.long_meaning: Anisha (Anisha) واژه‌ای از زبان عربی است که معنای اصلی آن Anisha می‌باشد. این نام در فارسی با همین صورت نوشته می‌شود و معنا در ترجمه توضیح داده شده است.

hindi.name: अनीशा
hindi.long_meaning: Anisha (अनीशा) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है जिसका मुख्य अर्थ उपहार है। हिंदी में यह नाम मूल रूप में लिखा जाता है और अर्थ उपहार के निकट है।

pashto.name: انيشه
pashto.long_meaning: Anisha (انيشه) د عربي ژبې یو نوم دی چې بنسټیزه مانا یې ډالۍ ده. پښتو کې دا نوم په همدې بڼه لیکل کیږي او مانا یې ډالۍ ته نږدې ده.

arabic.name: أنيشة
arabic.long_meaning: Anisha (أنيشة) اسم من أصل العربية ومعناه الأساسي هدية، عطية. يُكتب الاسم بالصيغة الأصلية ويُشرح معناه بالعربية دون ترجمة حرفية.

faq.q: What does the name Anisha mean?
faq.a: Anisha is used as a personal name; its recorded sense is 'Gift'.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Anisha?
faq.a: The name originates in Arabic, where the word carries the sense 'Gift', and it circulates in Muslim naming through established multilingual usage.
Yes. Anisha is an Arabic word used as a personal name.
Anisha is used as a Muslim given name, but it is not an Islamic religious term; it is a Arabic-origin word adopted within Muslim naming traditions.
No. Anisha does not occur in the Qur'an as a personal name, and no Qur'anic basis is claimed for it.
Anisha is romanized as a-nis-ha; no IPA transcription is asserted because none was verified.

faq.q: What does Anisha mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu the name is written انیشہ and conveys the sense given by its Arabic origin.

faq.q: Is Anisha a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Anisha as a female name; gender is taken from usage, not from the meaning.
